mainEntity.name: What kind of equipment is used in full-body circuit training at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Cave Training, our full-body circuit training utilizes a variety of equipment commonly found in functional fitness gyms to ensure a comprehensive workout. This can include kettlebells, dumbbells, resistance bands, medicine balls, battle ropes, and bodyweight exercises. The specific equipment used in a circuit might vary by class or session, ensuring variety and targeting different muscle groups. This diverse equipment selection allows for a broad range of exercises to keep workouts engaging and effective.
